data.rationale: The proposal captures the right procedure and order (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then a mail draft with the same subject and body templates), but it ends with "Send" where the true workflow says never to send and to click Discard. It also uses a separate recipient_email and recipient_name where the true workflow has a single friend parameter, and it leaves out the concrete search-box clicks and the Discard step, so an automation built from it would be risky.
